scope_change: The parent reported automatic safety screening of the preceding review turn and requested a narrower static review. No filesystem reproduction or mutation script was retried after that instruction. Earlier attempted recheck artifacts and the original ca95 review remain preserved; they are not the basis for this static verdict.

resolutions.requirement: The coordinator publishes only new declared candidates outside the source project, using the approved directory identity.
resolutions.source_evidence: Initialization holds source/output ancestry and rechecks separation. Publication creates descendants relative to the retained directory descriptors; it no longer resolves the caller target string again for writing. Component opens reject symlinks, identity checks compare directory descriptors with their parent-relative entries, and new files use exclusive non-following creation. Publication rereads final bytes before setting complete/location_verified. Initialization, child creation, publication and final coordinator cleanup close retained capabilities.
resolutions.limit: This source conclusion addresses the reported ordinary ownership/publication defect. It is not a universal filesystem-isolation guarantee, OS-level race certification or live-client result.

resolutions.requirement: Cancellation and handled operational failures retain accumulated run/call/version/check evidence and distinguish publication state.
resolutions.source_evidence: Coordinator.run catches cancellation and operational exceptions around the whole run and mutates the existing result through _interrupted rather than constructing an empty response. Existing calls, usage, unit versions and checks remain in that result. Initialization failures after plan validation preserve run_id. Publication tracks not_started/incomplete/complete, completed file identities and pending_path; integration_pending requires complete and location_verified. The CLI returns operational exit 3 for cancelled as well as unavailable, and both launchers include the new closed publication object.
resolutions.limit: The claim covers accumulated in-memory receipts and handled exceptions. It does not promise persistence after abrupt process death, power loss or an uncatchable termination.

resolutions.requirement: The fresh designated maker receives bounded exact-version failed/unknown obligation evidence, without contaminating independent reviewer/verifier contexts.
resolutions.source_evidence: Repair construction now retains every failed/unknown obligation judgment independently of findings. Each carries assessment_role, assessment_id, candidate_sha256 and version, while preserving expected/observed/reproduction/evidence fields. The next maker receives these judgments and the previous version's actual check receipts. Repair findings/obligations are exposed only for production/design roles. Acceptance invocations still supply empty prior-repair inputs, while the current execution verifier receives only current checks. If no actionable finding, failed/unknown judgment or failed check exists, repair returns repair_feedback_unavailable. EN/KO maker guidance describes the same behavior.
resolutions.limit: Complete transmission of bounded failure evidence is established in source; whether a model uses that evidence successfully remains a live behavior question.

remaining_qualification: Independent execution evidence must remain separately attributed to its verifier and exact commit.
Prepared contexts, source inspection and deterministic artifacts are not live Codex completion.
Live design/seeded repair, calculation-to-document and continuation remain separate qualification tasks.
No account/backend isolation or broad quality-benefit claim is made.
